news.title: Linda Sue Vogt: 1948-2026
news.summary_en: Linda Sue Vogt, whose generosity and steadfast support helped expand educational opportunities for Saint Louis University students, died June 14 at her home in Sunset Hills. She was 78.

news.title: St. Louis Shakespeare Festival TourCo to Perform on SLU's Quad Sept. 1
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University's quad will become center stage Sept. 1 as the St. Louis Shakespeare Festival TourCo makes its campus debut with a free outdoor performance of Shakespeare's The Two Gentlemen of Verona, directed by Rebekah Scallet.

news.title: Shacham Named to Newest FOCUS St. Louis Leadership Class
news.summary_en: Enbal Shacham, Ph.D., professor of Behavioral Science and Health Equity, has been named to the FOCUS St. Louis 51st Leadership St. Louis (LSL) class. Leadership St. Louis is a program for experienced leaders who have demonstrated a deep commitment to improving the St. Louis region, according to FOCUS St. Louis. Shacham was one of 57 people selected to take part in the 2026-27 class.

news.title: SLU Photographer Honored by University Photographers' Association of America
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University photographer Sarah Conroy has been recognized by the University Photographers' Association of America. Conroy took home two first-place finishes, two second-place finishes, and an honorable mention in the 2026 Annual Photo Competition for work done as SLU’s photographer. She also captured second-place overall in the Photographer of the Year competition.
